fusions.name: Bounding Prod
fusions.desc: A thrust of the rod that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Scatter the Glade
fusions.desc: A stamp of the rod that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Startled Release
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you and from everyone in your party. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Twelve-Point Crown
fusions.desc: Conjures a crown of antlers: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 12% more damage, you move 5% faster, your dodge chance rises by 3%, and each kill returns 2 health.
